description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractHiveMqttClientFactory' that provides common functionality for creating and configuring MQTT client instances for MQTT3 and MQTT5 protocols using the HiveMQ client library. It includes methods for setting up authentication, SSL/TLS configuration, and connection parameters, serving as a base for concrete factory classes.

classes.name: AbstractHiveMqttClientFactory
classes.description: An abstract class providing shared configuration logic for MQTT client factories for MQTT3 and MQTT5, including authentication setup, SSL tunneling, and connection parameters.

methods.name: configureSimpleAuth
methods.description: Configures simple username/password authentication for MQTT3 or MQTT5 builders based on the Connection object.

methods.name: configureClientBuilder
methods.description: Configures an MQTT client builder with server, SSL, reconnect, and listener settings based on the Connection object and parameters.
